chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Muawiya ibn Wahb, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Whoever guarantees four (matters) for me, I will guarantee for him four houses in Paradise: Spend (in charity) and do not fear poverty, and spread the greeting of peace throughout the world, and leave disputing even if you are right, and be fair to people with yourself.
ai.seo_question: What are the four actions guaranteed to bring four houses in Paradise according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links specific social ethics to spiritual reward, emphasizing that generosity, peace, humility in debate, and self-accountability are keys to Paradise. This teaching reflects the Shia emphasis on *adab* (etiquette) and *mu'amalat* (social conduct) as integral to faith, encouraging believers to prioritize justice and harmony in their interactions with the wider world.
